question: Which joint structural consequences follow from four independently defined finite process classes, with TFPT used only for later comparison?
summary_de: Fundamentaler Richtungswechsel: TFPT ist Vergleichsdatenbestand. Für beliebige endliche deterministische Prozessfunktionen erzwingt Existenz unter allen gemeinsam lokal gesteuerten Replikaten genau einen azyklischen Abhängigkeitsgraphen und damit eindeutige Lösungen. Drei binäre Schnittstellen: 744 einmalig konsistente Prozesse, davon 488 azyklisch; alle übrigen 256 scheitern an zwei Kopien mit reversibler lokaler Kontrolle. Vier Ausgangsklassen und ihre Gegenwelten sind geprüft. Keine physikalische Zeit, Quantenstruktur oder TFPT-Trägerstruktur hergeleitet. Der Folgeauftrag trennt Beobachtbarkeit von Wiederholbarkeit und prüft drei operationell nicht äquivalente Gegenmodelle: deterministische Lesespuren, klassischer Simplex und Quadrat mit störenden wiederholbaren Instrumenten. XZX trennt die beiden statistischen Modelle mit1 versus1/2; eine unbeschränkte klassische Historienmaschine reproduziert endliche präfixkonsistente Tabellen. Gemeinsame Folgen liefern keine neue physikalische Auswahl.
summary_en: Fundamental reset: TFPT is comparison data. For arbitrary finite deterministic process functions, existence under all jointly locally controlled replicas is equivalent to an acyclic influence graph and entails unique solutions. Three binary interfaces: 744 one-shot consistent functions, 488 acyclic; the other 256 fail with two copies and reversible local control. Four starting classes and counterworlds are examined. No physical time, quantum or TFPT carrier structure is derived. The follow-up separates observation from repeatability and checks three operationally inequivalent countermodels: deterministic readout traces, a classical simplex and a square with disturbing repeatable instruments. XZX separates the statistical models at1 versus1/2; an unrestricted classical history machine reproduces finite prefix-consistent tables. Shared consequences do not select new physical structure.
assumptions: Explicit finite classical deterministic models; no target TFPT structures as inputs.
General composition theorem: every finite replica count and every joint same-interface deterministic control, including erasure, constants, encoders and decoders.
Independent copies act coordinatewise and corresponding interfaces can be grouped.
Poset, information and monoid starting data are separately declared; their stipulated states/order/steps are not relabelled emergent.
positive_results: General finite-alphabet equivalence: all-copy existence, all-copy uniqueness, influence DAG, compatibility with at least one fixed total order.
Binary three-interface complete 744/488/256 classification; 256 explicit two-copy reversible witnesses independently reproduced.
Poset ideals/history structure and invariant growth-law nonuniqueness; finite censuses through four elements.
Precisely scoped stable record cells, cyclic phase orbits and classical noncommuting operations; counterworlds distinguish these from physical emergence.

Three operationally inequivalent single-system countermodels satisfy explicitly separate repeatable-distinction requirements; no probability, convex geometry or joint accessibility is inferred from observation alone.
Exact rational XZX discriminator I=1 versus D=1/2 on all four corner preparations; D diagonal mixtures are equal under all generated protocols, while I parity distinguishes them.

Finite-horizon normalized prefix-consistent sequential tables admit a classical full-history realization with no resource/locality/noncontextuality restrictions; exact reconstruction verified on all requested D tables through horizon4.
Result repeatability does not imply full instrument idempotence, non-disturbance of another test, global information conservation or a protected physical memory.
not_derived: Unique physical history, metric, spacetime, locality, physical events, material memory, quantum mechanics, E8, five-direction carrier, 3+2, quartic field or TFPT clocks.
A universal TFPT underdetermination theorem or completed full P1/P2 countermodels.
General reversible-only composition theorem or a general two-copy bound.
Physical necessity of full local control, free grouping or exact deterministic replication.
A classification of all operational theories, unique probability law, fundamental randomness, physical causality or physical state-space geometry from observability.
Exclusion of all classical implementations by serial disturbance or a square operational quotient; no bipartite quantum, Bell or locality claim.
independent_review: Two mathematical reviews accepted the general cycle argument; an independent tuple implementation reproduced all 744 process/order entries and all 256 witness fixed-point sets. Scope corrections distinguish record cells from invariant total record functions and interface orders from event occurrence histories.
current_question: Which operational properties are necessary for repeatable observable distinctions, and which inequivalent models and empirical discriminators remain?

operational_success_levels.L2: conditional structural/representation theorems with explicit premises
operational_success_levels.L3: physical explanation with independently supported premises and new empirical predictive content; not achieved

operational_independent_review: Mathematical review accepted all equations, instruments and history construction after replacing an overbroad classification headline. The result exhibits countermodels, not a classification of all theories.
